subject: test(multiple): clean up DI in tests (#30848)
decision: Decline the upstream testing-DI cleanup after reviewing all 33 complete files and 87 hunks, including both documentation tests. Record hook merges, earlier service/container capture, root-provider assumptions, the observerFactory alias, the Core inject alias and all two zone-case suite moves individually. Documentation teardown changes receive their own review. No claim that service creation, cleanup, initialization or error timing is interchangeable. Preserve historical manual constructors, distinct legacy tokens and owned/public peer boundaries; no component/CDK fork or required consumer edit follows. Read-only Cyph sanity confirms existing legacy module/markup/style bindings; no consumer edit. Actual packed/native/browser/SSR/compiler/Node/RxJS/exact-peer floors and independent audit remain required.
